messages:
emma: Heads-up — CloudBroker preview stream is getting rejected by the staging gatekeeper. ~10% rejects, 5xx -> 422 in the logs. Pinging @mike @sanjay for quick triage.

mike: Can you paste one example payload? is this a new schema version from them?

emma: Here's a sanitized sample we pulled from the error batch:
```json
{
  "acct": "CB-12345",
  "usage": {
    "tokens_consumed": 1200,
    "model": "gpt-4o-mini"
  },
  "timestamp": "2026-03-20T18:12:34Z"
  // note: no event_id or customer_id
}
```

sanjay: Looks like they renamed `customer_id` -> `acct` (and omitted `event_id`). Gatekeeper schema validation is strict in staging. We added alias mapping in prod last month but never propagated to staging. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

taylor: If we accept `acct` as an alias we need a dedupe/idempotency plan. Without `event_id` we could double-bill on replay. Do we have any fallback id to use? :eyes:

emma: This sample doesn't include `event_id`. Partner PM said their SDK only emits it after next deploy (ETA 48h). :confused:

mike: Proposed mitigation: 1) add `acct` -> `customer_id` alias in staging config, 2) enable soft-accept mode that ingests but tags events as `pending_verification`, 3) compute an envelope id if `event_id` missing (hash of payload) to de-dupe short-term. I'll open a PR. Anyone object to a 2h testing window?

taylor: Ok but mark those events as non-billable until we verify. I'll run an automated reconciliation after the window.

sanjay: I'll add header fallback `x-envelope-id` generation and a 24h dedupe window in the gatekeeper. That should prevent accidental double-charge during partner replay.

ingest-bot: ALERT: staging-gatekeeper rejected 47 CloudBroker events in the last 15m — https://logs.internal/redwood/staging/gatekeeper?query=CloudBroker (rate spike).

emma: I'll ask CloudBroker to pause their preview stream and send a corrected batch for replay once we flip the flag. cc @chris from partnerships to coordinate communication.

chris: On it. I'll ask them to freeze ingestion and produce a 1k-event sample with correct fields for us to spot-check. Also requesting a short MOU to avoid further semantic drift while we finalize the contract.

mike: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/ingest/pull/985 — includes alias mapping + soft-accept + envelope-id fallback. Planning a small prod-like deploy to staging at 22:30 PT if no objections.

taylor: SGTM. I'll provision a reconciliation job to run tomorrow 07:00 PT to compare pre/post counts and flag any anomalies.

emma: Thanks all — will follow up after deploy + partner replay. :pray:
